name: Total from possessions, not from scoring averages
signal: project the total as pace x points-per-possession, pace from the official advanced page and ppp as the mean of each club's own rate and its opponent's allowed rate; an average of two points-per-game figures is not used at any point
universe: games of the round window present on all three official team-stat pages
settlement_rule: TOTAL: over if the game's official final total exceeds the originated total, under if below, push and void if equal
luck_policy: refused for any club outside the +/-2 luck band
